## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Safety and Compatibility

- Does this change send writes or trigger a high-risk action?
- Does it change MSP, Betaflight-version, command, flag, or JSON compatibility?
- What failure modes were considered?

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Generated metadata verified when relevant
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changed

## Release Note

Describe the release-note entry, or write `None` for an internal-only change.
